tool_schemas.name: get_1password_credentials
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the requested secret fields from a 1Password item in the specified vault, returning only the fields listed in `fields` and recording an audit log entry keyed by `request_id`; when available, the server may satisfy the request from a cached retrieval session to reduce repeated 1Password lookups. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the caller’s effective access policy does not allow the vault/item (or title-based lookup) or any requested field, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS if the caller exceeds configured rate/quota limits. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required inputs are missing or `fields` contains unsupported values, NOT_FOUND when the referenced vault or item cannot be resolved (including no policy-allowable match for `item_title`), and CONFLICT when `request_id` is reused for a different retrieval intent.

vault_id.description: 1Password vault identifier to retrieve the item from.

item_title.description: 1Password item title to retrieve (used when item_id is not provided and must be policy-allowable).

fields.description: Requested secret fields to return; must be permitted by the caller's effective credential policy.

request_id.description: Caller-supplied idempotency/audit identifier echoed into audit logs for traceability.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated API client identity derived from the presented API key, including its status, effective scopes, and current quota/rate-limit state. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, and FORBIDDEN if the client is not active.

api_key.description: Client API key presented for authentication; compared against stored api_key_hash using a constant-time check.

tool_schemas.name: list_credential_policies
tool_schemas.description: Lists credential policies visible to the authenticated client, supporting filtering by status and effect. Returns a paginated list; refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is invalid and FORBIDDEN if the client is not active.

api_key.description: Client API key presented for authentication.

item_title_match.description: Filter policies by title match expression (exact matching semantics are server-defined).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return per page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: create_credential_policy
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new credential access policy for the authenticated client. Returns the created policy. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is invalid, FORBIDDEN if the client is not active, and UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY if the policy is invalid (e.g., no match criteria, empty allowed_fields for allow, or conflicting inputs).

api_key.description: Client API key presented for authentication.

vault_id.description: 1Password vault identifier this policy applies to.

item_id.description: 1Password item identifier this policy applies to.

item_title_match.description: 1Password item title match expression used when item_id is not specified.

allowed_fields.description: Fields the client may retrieve when this policy matches. For effect='deny', this may be omitted to deny all fields for the match.

effect.description: Whether this policy allows or denies access when it matches (deny overrides allow).

status.description: Initial lifecycle status of the policy.

tool_schemas.name: update_credential_policy
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing credential policy belonging to the authenticated client, including lifecycle status transitions. Returns the updated policy. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is invalid, FORBIDDEN if the client is not active, NOT_FOUND if the policy does not exist, and CONFLICT if the requested status transition is not allowed.

api_key.description: Client API key presented for authentication.

vault_id.description: Updated 1Password vault identifier this policy applies to.

item_id.description: Updated 1Password item identifier this policy applies to.

allowed_fields.description: Updated allowed fields for effect='allow'. For effect='deny', omit to deny all fields for the match.

status.description: Updated lifecycle status; allowed transitions: active<->disabled.

tool_schemas.name: list_retrieval_audit_logs
tool_schemas.description: Lists retrieval audit log entries for the authenticated client for traceability and incident response. Returns a paginated list; refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is invalid and FORBIDDEN if the client is not active.

api_key.description: Client API key presented for authentication.

vault_id.description: Filter by 1Password vault identifier referenced by the audit entry.

item_id.description: Filter by 1Password item identifier referenced by the audit entry.

from_created_at.description: Filter to entries created at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

to_created_at.description: Filter to entries created at or before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return per page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: update_retrieval_session
tool_schemas.description: Updates a retrieval session belonging to the authenticated client, primarily to drive lifecycle transitions (e.g., revoke an active session). Returns the updated session. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is invalid, FORBIDDEN if the client is not active, NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist, and CONFLICT if the requested status transition is not allowed (active->revoked/failed/expired; failed->expired).

api_key.description: Client API key presented for authentication.

status.description: New session status. Only lifecycle-allowed transitions are accepted; attempting to reactivate an expired/revoked session is refused.

failure_reason.description: Optional failure reason when transitioning to status='failed' (secret material must never be included).

metadata.name: 1Password Credential Retrieval Server
metadata.description: This backend powers a minimal credential retrieval service that returns 1Password-stored secrets to authorized callers.
